name: claudinator
description: Give Claude Code a glow-up: switchable looks and mixable ingredients for tool calls, the thinking line and turn receipts. Draws locally, makes no network requests.

look.title: Look
look.description: The look Claudinator starts with. Your choice in the /claudinator picker takes precedence.

recency.title: Recency fade
recency.description: Older rows fade so your eye lands on the newest.

miniDiffs.title: Mini diffs
miniDiffs.description: Edits show their key changed lines under the row.

fileColors.title: File colors
fileColors.description: Each file keeps one color everywhere.

quiet.title: Quiet transcript
quiet.description: Hide reads, searches and passing commands; keep Claude's prose and the changes.
